blocks.title: Logistic regression
blocks.text: Logistic regression haan ya nahi wale nateeje ki pesh-goi karta hai. Theek adad ki bajaye 0 aur 1 ke darmiyan imkan deta hai: P = 1 / (1 + e^-(b0 + b1 x)), jahan e natural logarithm ki bunyad, b0 intercept (x = 0 par log-odds) aur b1 x ki har ikai par log-odds ki tabdeeli hai.

blocks.caption: Parhai ke ghante aur exam nataij

blocks.text: 0.85 ka andaza pass hone ka 85% imkan hai. Kitab b0 = 1 aur b1 = 0.6 farz karti hai. In qeematon se 5 ghante par P = 1 / (1 + e^-4), taqreeban 0.98, aur 4 ghante par 1 / (1 + e^-3.4), taqreeban 0.97. Yeh farz shuda coefficients data par bhi poore nahi utarte, kyunke 1 ghanta parh kar fail hone wale ke liye bhi pass ka andaza dete hain. Is data par baitha model manfi intercept rakhega, to us ka imkan 3 aur 4 ghante ke darmiyan 0.5 paar karega.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab 5 ghante ke liye P(Pass) taqreeban 0.83 (83% imkan) aur 4 ghante ke liye 73% imkan chhapti hai. b0 = 1 aur b1 = 0.6 se 5 ghante par b0 + b1 x = 1 + 3 = 4, to P = 1 / (1 + e^-4), taqreeban 0.98 (98%); 4 ghante par 1 + 2.4 = 3.4, to P taqreeban 0.97 (97%). Kitab ke 0.83 aur 0.73 asal mein 1 ghante (1.6) aur 0 ghante (1) ki qeematein hain.

blocks.alt: Graph: ufuqi mehwar par parhai ke ghante (0 se 7), amudi par pass ka imkan (0 se 1). 1, 2, 3 ghante wale surkh nuqte 0 (fail) par aur 4, 5, 6 ghante wale hare nuqte 1 (pass) par. Jamni curve kitab ke b0 = 1, b1 = 0.6 se bana hai: 0 ghante par taqreeban 0.73 se shuru ho kar 1 ki taraf barhta hai.
blocks.caption: Pass ya fail ka data aur kitab ke b0 = 1, b1 = 0.6 wala logistic curve (asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Graph dekhein: kitab ke b0 = 1 aur b1 = 0.6 wala curve 0 ghante par bhi taqreeban 0.73 hai, yani 1, 2 aur 3 ghante parhne walon ko bhi pass ka bara imkan deta hai, halanke woh fail hue. Is liye yeh coefficients is data par poore nahi utarte; data par theek baitha curve 3 aur 4 ghante ke darmiyan 0 se 1 ki taraf tezi se uthega.

blocks.prompt: Logistic regression linear regression se kaise mukhtalif hai?
blocks.explanation: Linear regression seedhi line par adad ki pesh-goi karta hai; logistic regression S-shakal curve par haan ya nahi nateeje ka imkan (0 se 1) batata hai.

items: Logistic regression: P = 1 / (1 + e^-(b0 + b1 x)) pass ka imkan 0 aur 1 ke darmiyan deta hai.
